headline: Khimani & Associates, Ascendus Law Partners advise on BTG Sale to Nikhil Kamath's WTF
sum: Nikhil Kamath’s WTF has acquired BTG (By The Gram), a Mumbai-based creative agency. Khimani & Associates advised BTG and its founders Aaliya Amrin, Eman Batliwalla, and Danisha Kohli on this transaction.
detail: Nikhil Kamath’s WTF has acquired BTG (By The Gram), a Mumbai-based creative agency. Khimani & Associates advised BTG and its founders Aaliya Amrin, Eman Batliwalla, and Danisha Kohli on this transaction. The transaction was led by Priyanka Khimani (Founder and Managing Partner), Mohak Kapoor (Senior Associate) and Saniya Gandotra (Associate). Priyanka Khimani Ascendus Law Partners acted for WTF on this acquisition.
